description: This 3D model presents an elegant table lamp with a classic design. It features a conical lampshade characterized by distinct vertical pleats or ribs. The lampshade sits atop a gracefully twisted column, which forms the main stem of the lamp. The column connects to a wide, ornate base adorned with intricate sculpted details and supported by four decorative feet, suggesting a traditional or baroque aesthetic. The entire object is rendered in a clean, monochrome white or light grey, emphasizing its form and decorative elements. It is designed to be both functional as a light source and a decorative accent.
